meta.title: Why I Never Toast my Bagel (But Really Do) | Kenji's Cooking Show
meta.description: I'm a bagel snob. I admit it. As such, I never order my bagel toasted, and I never slice and toast it at  home. But I do toast it. Sort of. Here's some more: https://www.seriouseats.com/2015/09/how-to-reheat-old-bagels.html
chapters: The secret to a great bagel
